div.div: from the brand's shoot, one source of many
garments, parts and details, with the ontology's terms
every term is looked up in the ontology
one individual per garment, typed by its kind
a class becomes a Category node, a value an Attribute node, a part a HAS_PART edge

div.span: what the ingest step writes into the graph

div.div: A second photo with the same kind of garment links to the SAME Category node, so looks meet through what they share.
